description: Partially update (patch) one or multiple existing records by primary key. Mutates data, enforcing RLS & FLS. Pass `item` for a single update OR `items` for batch updates (not both). Each object MUST include the table's primary key (`<tableName>id`) plus at least one field to update (only provided fields are modified). Bulk updates are non-atomic and return `{ count, items: [{ status: 'ok', item }], errors: [{ status: 'error', index, message }] }`. Use `create_rows` for new records or `delete_rows` to remove records.

item.description: Single row patch object (use either `item` or `items`). Must include PK and >=1 field to update.

items.description: Array of row patch objects for batch update (use either `items` or `item`). Each must include PK.

returnFields.description: Optional list of field names to include in each returned `item`.

name: update_rows
